product.name: Ultrasonic Sensor Module (Part No. 0060858035)
product.description: A functional component in the automatic water filling system of smart refrigerators that detects water levels inside a container using ultrasonic signal transmission and reception. It consists of a front plastic bracket and two integrated ultrasonic sensor modules made of a PCB, piezo element, wire harness, plastic housing, and rubber parts.

operations.name: Align PCB with the piezo element, solder, and trim excess pins
Perform electrical validation including capacitance measurement and polarity verification
Perform waterproof sealing by inserting piezo element into rubber sleeve and shell and curing sealant
Perform individual module functional testing including echo testing
Integrate two completed sensor modules with a plastic bracket to form the dual-sensor water level detection assembly
Perform system-level functional testing to ensure proper pairing and synchronization
